# Benchmark runs<AvailableFrom v="3.2.28" />

Specify how many times the video should be rendered during a benchmark. Default `3`.

## CLI flag

```text
--runs <value>
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion benchmark`](/docs/cli/benchmark)

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';
// ---cut---
Config.setBenchmarkRuns(5);
```
